scientific_question: Is any legally encoded F62-native memory consolidation action capable of adding five-/six-hop compositional reachability while preserving all baseline native-memory path signatures through four hops, and could such an action rescue a previously failing six-step task without losing F60-correct reasoning? This is a retrospective necessary-condition test, not proof of online learnability or prospective scientific gain.
mechanistic_difference: F98 maximized learned frequent two-role bigram coverage and regressed six four-step guard cases. F99 tests query-independent causal role-path closure, including entity endpoints and signed ordered role paths, as an explicit safety invariant. A future phase may form higher-order records or train a causal selector, but this prereg DOES NOT authorize that implementation.

records_and_closure.native_record: (source_endpoint, target_endpoint, tuple_of_signed_role_codes) from exact frozen F62 native memory; 12 records x 12 packed bytes = <=144 bytes
records_and_closure.directed_expansion: For each record include native forward endpoint path and its exact reverse: exchange endpoints and reverse the sequence, toggling each signed role direction bit with XOR 1. Do not manufacture semantic edges not represented by native packed records.
records_and_closure.concatenation: Join only when prior terminal endpoint equals next source endpoint, append signed role-code tuples in order, never exceed requested length bound. Enumerate exact distinct (start, signed_role_tuple, end) signatures; do not count duplicate signatures twice.
records_and_closure.safety_invariant: For an actual F60 baseline afterstate B and a source-native alternative A at the SAME public prefix, require every distinct baseline signature of length 1..4 to be present in A. No future source events, question, answer, source-family labels, or treatment labels may appear in computing closure.
records_and_closure.exploratory_gain: Record count of additional distinct signatures of length 5..6 in A relative to B; a strictly positive gain is required for hypothetical intervention. Count per-task later correctness only offline for this retired-source feasibility audit.
records_and_closure.complexity_control: Bound enumeration by immutable maximum 250000 distinct signatures per candidate and per length <=6; if exceeded classify SOURCE_RESOURCE_INELIGIBLE, never silently truncate, approximate, drop inconvenient signatures, raise memory budget or relax invariants.

controls.frozen_baseline: F60 exact source-native 72-prefix memory decisions + identical frozen F85 global reasoning
controls.native_alternatives: ONLY legal exact F62.actions(memory,event,index,pack) afterstates; first pass one deviation at index 0..47 followed by unchanged F60 suffix; identical native record cap
controls.public_observability: Retrospective outcome auditor may see eventual question/answer ONLY after frozen memory trajectories are constructed. This hindsight information never becomes an online policy input.
controls.paired_graph: Preserve both F96 original and rotate4 treatments of the exact same source graph; verify identical underlying edges and task/answer. Report each separately.
controls.no_extra_memory: No learned model, extra persistent records, confidence side channel or controller latch is granted by this feasibility stage.

allowed_data.scope: Only previously consumed synthetic cohorts from F93B/F94, F96 and F98 used as RETROSPECTIVE diagnostic material; retain each source identity and prior first-use status. No novel training, validation or guard source opened by this gate.
allowed_data.f93b_f94_retired_guard: F76 families on seeds -6041 through -6056, all already consumed; source-only retrospective reuse
allowed_data.f96_retired_holdout: F76 families on seeds -6241 through -6256, both matched arrival orders, consumed
allowed_data.f98_retired_holdout: F76 families on seeds -6421 through -6428 and -6441 through -6456, both matched arrival orders, consumed
allowed_data.forbidden: Protected FIT/DIAG/ORIGINAL/F3; novel cohort first-use; reclassifying any old result as fresh; tuning thresholds or grammar on consumed guard

predetermined_feasibility_gate.minimum: Find at least one previously missed six-step F60 task where a single legal F62 alternative is closure-preserving at <=4 hops, adds >=1 distinct five-/six-hop signature, and leads to a correct final F85 response after unchanged F60 suffix. If zero, F99 feasibility FAILS and no proposed selector is justified by this path.
predetermined_feasibility_gate.harm_report: Independently count every closure-preserving candidate that regresses a previously F60-correct four-step case; report both total and per-order. Any such candidate falsifies claims that this local invariant guarantees final correctness.
predetermined_feasibility_gate.classify: RETROSPECTIVE_FEASIBLE_ONLY if minimum met, otherwise RETROSPECTIVE_NO_WITNESS. Either way NOT ACCEPTED SCIENCE, and no prospective positive can be claimed.
predetermined_feasibility_gate.negative_controls: All native candidates packed/validated under exact 144B bound; exact F60 action present once; deterministic source and solver hashes; all 72 prefixes independently traced; exact paired graph equality; no F85 resource caps.
predetermined_feasibility_gate.next_gate: Only after a complete retrospective outcome, separately freeze a genuinely causal online memory-formation/selection method, identity-proven training/validation/guard source cohorts and zero-four-hop-loss acceptance design BEFORE constructing or reading novel source data. Never choose a method by optimizing consumed guard outcomes.

qualification.focused_tests: Independent unit tests for path orientation/reverse sign, endpoint joins, deduplicated closure signatures, zero loss preservation, native legal action, bounded enumeration, resource rejection and absent future-query inputs.
qualification.affected_interfaces: Exact F62 legal actions, 12x12B packer and frozen F85 query-time solver must remain immutable; exact SHA/blob verification fail closed.
qualification.full_regression: After bounded implementation and focused qualification, run one complete required integration regression on the exact candidate head before scientific holdout or build/admission. Focused caches valid only for identical semantic source/toolchain/harness keys.
phase_labels: P0 freeze this prereg alone on draft branch
P1 implement bounded retrospective-only enumerator with unit tests
P2 run retrospective diagnostic on consumed sources in authorized existing research path, archive exact receipt
P3 only if feasible separately preregister new query-blind online mechanism and fresh cohorts
